title: Inadequate Consent
description: The homeowner may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Integrity Risks
description: The Home Hub may process or store data incorrectly, leading to potential inaccuracies in the homeowner's account or sensor data.

title: Data Disclosure Risks
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently disclose sensitive information about the homeowner or their environment to unauthorized parties.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: Data collected by the Home Hub may be used for purposes other than those originally intended, such as marketing or profiling without the homeowner's knowledge.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The guest user may be linked to their actions or identity through the temporary access code they enter, which could be observed or intercepted by unauthorized parties.

title: Data Disclosure Threat
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently disclose the guest user's identity or access patterns if the data is not properly secured or if logs are maintained without adequate privacy measures.

title: Interception Threat
description: The data flow of the temporary access code could be intercepted during transmission, allowing unauthorized parties to gain access to the Home Hub.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Home Hub (P1) may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to trigger events that are logged in the Local Event Log (DS1). This could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive event data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may store sensitive motion/door/sensor events without proper encryption or security measures, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may retain event data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Home Hub may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to upload or access recorded camera clips.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The Cloud Video Storage may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to recorded camera clips.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Recorded camera clips may be intercepted during transmission from the Home Hub to the Cloud Video Storage, exposing sensitive information.

title: Excessive Exposure of Personal Data
description: The Home Hub forwards a real-time motion alert which may contain personal data, potentially exposing it excessively to the Mobile App Backend, which could lead to unintended disclosures.

title: Inadequate Data Handling by Mobile App Backend
description: The Mobile App Backend may process or store the motion alert data in a way that exposes personal data to unauthorized parties, either through inadequate security measures or improper data sharing practices.

title: Inadequate Authentication
description: The mobile app backend may not have strong authentication mechanisms, allowing unauthorized users to receive notifications meant for the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The homeowner's device may store notifications insecurely, making them accessible to unauthorized applications or users.

title: Data Misuse
description: The homeowner may inadvertently share the motion-detected notifications with others, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently share more detailed analytics than intended, leading to potential exposure of sensitive user information.

title: Inadequate Data Handling
description: The cloud analytics vendor may not handle the aggregated analytics properly, leading to potential identification of individual users through the aggregated data.

title: Data Misuse
description: The cloud analytics vendor could misuse the aggregated analytics for purposes not agreed upon, such as selling the data to third parties.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The cloud analytics vendor may use the aggregated data in ways that were not intended or disclosed to the users, leading to privacy violations.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: Personal data is stored longer than needed when the mobile app backend retrieves the video clip for playback.
